desc: This is a family run Iranian restaurant with excellent Persian cuisine. Marinated lamb kebabs and the vegetarian khoreshteh esphinaj (stew) are recommended. Don't forget to order the delicious tea at the end of your meal

name: Taverna Ousies
desc: One of the best Greek restaurants along town. Always wise to make a reservation, sometimes a bit noisy.

name: Wiesenstein
desc: Excellent Schwäbisches Food with good Schwaben wines in nice surrounding and neat garden

name: Ypsilon
desc: Serving tasty Greek dishes with a good wine selection to match. Has a big biergarten for the balmy summer nights and plays live Greek music on Friday and Saturday.

name: Mar y Sol
desc: Tapas and Spanish food

name: Eiffel
desc: Good French restaurant with good value business lunch sets and interesting dinner variations.

name: 12 Apostel
desc: Excellent Italian food and one of the best pizzas in town, Bleibtreustr. 49 (opposite S-Bahnstation Savignyplatz), 10623 Berlin (in Charlottenburg, and Hohenzollerndamm 33 in Wilmersdorf. Branches in Steglitz and Mitte.

name: Kuchi
desc: One of the best sushi restaurants in Berlin. Also serves good pan Asian dishes.

name: Moustache
desc: Excellent cuisine franchise next to the river, for the expatriate French in Berlin.

name: Sankt Moritz
desc: Member of "Chaine des Rotisseurs" with outstanding wine card and excellent cuisine in rooms made by German painter. Named "Maitre of the year 2008".

name: Daitokai
desc: The best teppanyaki grill in town.

name: Brauhaus Lemke am Schloß
desc: Excellent brewed beer. You can have either a helles (light) or a dunkles (dark). Although the beer is quite excellent, the atmosphere is quite touristy, and clearly not as antique as it strives to be.

name: Coma
desc: Made up with sand on the floor and two pool tables. XL Cocktails will kick you faster than you would think.

name: Green Door
desc: One of the best cocktail bars in Berlin with excellent selection of spirits and a stylish decor to match.

name: Green Mango
desc: The biggest karaokebar in Europe and they also have 150.000 karaoke playback.

name: Leydicke
desc: One of the famous Berlin watering holes with a wide range of fruit wines, being drunk in nearly unchanged setting for the last 100 years. If the party gets started, among the best places in Berlin. Dangerous, when you co

name: Salut!
desc: Cafe/bar that offers an impressive cocktail list. Cocktails are mixed with fresh juices and matched with quality spirits.

name: Train
desc: As its name suggests, this bar is actually in an old S-Bahn car. Flashy and famous for inspired cocktails served by friendly bartenders.

name: Zur U-Bahn
desc: One of the last old time Berlin bars in the area, and a great place to sit, drink and meet the locals.

name: Gitan Wein und Feinkost
desc: Small wine bar with seats on footpath and some inside. Charming tree lined street. The proprietor and the shop look to be at least 500 years old perhaps more. Good selection of wine and charcuterie inside. This is not th

name: Zig Zag Jazz Club
desc: Very small cafe/bar with plenty of seating. Musicians play their original compositions most nights of the week. Quality is very high. Small snacks served but probably best to eat before you go as there is not much room.

name: Cascade
desc: similar to the Maxxim, but less r'n'b music, for the wealthy people of Charlottenburg. Nice interior, plays house and 70s/80s.

name: Havanna
desc: Largest Latin music club in town. Dance to the beat when it's open on Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday nights.

name: Heideglühen
desc: Sheltered open-air location at the waterside right across from the Westhafen harbor with techno, house, electro DJs.

name: Maxxim
desc: A bit more luxurious for the more mature crowd. Mainly R'n'B and house.

name: Q-dorf
desc: Named after the Ku'Damm, this big disco attracts a very young (and drunken) crowd. Rather cheap and usually very crowded with all the stuff you need (or don't want): R'n'B straight from the charts, Eurotrash party music,

name: Cafe & Restaurant Louis
desc: Austrian food, giant schnitzels and quality beer on tap.

name: Café Jacques
desc: Great French cuisine (especially the fish and the self-made noodles), nice service, very crowded though.

name: Cafe Rix
desc: Next to the Neukölln Opera house with international cuisine.

name: Tabibito
desc: Japanese restaurant, family-run, very friendly (sometimes you get a snack for free), since it's little, can be very crowded in the evenings.

name: TanzCafé Britz
price: €3.90 and up, items over €10 are rare
desc: Hidden away in a residential area. Cute café/restaurant with lots of dancing activities and excellent and really cheap food prepared by a French chef.

name: Café Selig
desc: Cute café/restaurant in the Schillerkiez by the church. Good place to people-watch, drink a coffee, and to eat brunch.

name: Zio Felix
desc: Good pizza.

name: Britzer Mühle
desc: Classical German cuisine in an old wind mill.

name: Casa Montella
desc: Good Italian restaurant in Rudow.

name: Arcaoda
desc: This club in an old bowling alley offers electro club nights, live music performances, independent music, art exhibitions and food.

name: Brauhaus Rixdorf
desc: Traditional brewery with a very nice biergarten, lovely in summer. The food is typical Bavarian fare, and of pretty good quality.

name: Klunkerkranich
desc: Popular rooftop club, beach bar, sundeck or garden on top of a parking garage with a fantastic view over Neukölln. Generous indoor space and even more outdoor. Live music and DJs playing electro, funk, disco or jazz. Tak

name: Kulturverein Kinski
desc: Famous for late nights and cultural activities. Frequented by Neukölln film enthusiasts, and occasionally rare films are screened. A nice feature: if you want to organise an artistic event or plan to DJ, just go there an

name: Frollein Langner
desc: Furnished with several sofas it has a living room atmosphere. They serve Bavarian beer and small snacks. The main room is non-smoking. There is a separate room for smokers.

name: Froschkönig Pianobar
desc: Awesome pianobar with literature nights and occasional jazz concerts. Very relaxed atmosphere, located in the Schillerkiez.

name: Syndikat
desc: One of the most famous bars in this part of town. It's been around for some 25 years and considered to be one of the best 'Kneipen' in Neukölln.

name: asiagourmet
desc: Asian take-away.

name: Starbucks
desc: coffee.

name: Carlsberg Nordic Bar
desc: snacks and drinks.

name: EsS-Bahn
desc: New branch of the famous Berlin takeaway located in an old railway coach. Formerly located in front of Tegel Airport.

name: Mövenpick Café
desc: Snacks and drinks

name: Kamps
desc: German bakery chain.

name: Mövenpick marché Sandwich Manufaktur
desc: Sandwiches, hot and cold drinks for takeaway after arriving by plane.

name: basta!
desc: pasta and pizza, takeaway or seated service.

name: Ständige Vertretung
desc: Branch of the infamous upscale restaurant in Berlin's city centre. Named after the former West German embassy-in-all-but-name for the GDR and well known meeting place for current-day politicians.

name: Burger King
desc: fast food

name: Blaue Lagune
desc: A coffeeshop/restaurant where you can have great coffee, house-made excellent ice cream and cakes, and great food from a short but just as excellent menu, and all that in a wonderful ambiente. Nestled in a corner of Joha

name: Klipper
desc: This firmly anchored restaurant ship is certainly one of the most beautiful venues for having dinner in Treptow and Berlin.

name: Luise Restaurant and Bar
desc: Friendly service, delicious German/Italian food and a great view over the Dahme and the Spree both from inside and outside on the big wooden terrace.

name: Müggelseefischerei
desc: This fishery right next to the ferry terminal offers fresh and smoked fish caught in Müggelsee since more than 35 years.

name: Neu Helgoland
desc: One of Berlin's most beautiful waterside restaurants with over 100 years of tradition. Regular events such as concerts and comedy, often with popular East German bands. Locals usually arrive by boat.

name: Rübezahl
desc: This waterside restaurant with beer garden named after the folklore mountain spirit is one of the best-known and oldest at Müggelsee and offers delicious meals, dinner events, weddings and an [http://ruebezahl-berlin.de/

name: Schmetterlingshorst
desc: This history of this cozy pub for hikers, sportsmen and day-trippers at Langer See and its butterfly collection can be traced back to the year 1898.

name: Westernrestaurant Richtershorn am See
desc: Old style Western restaurant at the waterside with a log cabin, outdoor terrace, dancehall, wharf, zoo and winter garden as well as a beautiful view over the Langer See lake.

name: Dresdner Feinbäckerei
desc: This tradition-rich confectionery and café which was founded in 1906 offers backed goods, cookies and cakes from Saxony as well as coffee. Regular events such as readings take place at the café.

name: Köpenick Palace Cafe
desc: Both inside and outside are beautiful places to have a glass of wine or beer or a cup of coffee with a whipped cream cake. Also have menus for lunch and dinner.

name: Arena Club
desc: This techno club in a raw and run-down old boiler room of 500 m² provides the perfect atmosphere for hard industrial techno. It has one dance floor and two bars and an impressive light installation at the ceiling. Next t

name: Club der Visionäre
desc: Atmospheric club at the waterside well-known for minimal techno, house and techno-house and high-grade DJ bookings. Originally only a summer venue, it now also has an indoor winter location at the MS Hoppetosse excursion

name: Else
desc: Open-air techno club and beer garden at the Elsenbrücke bridge which is made out of shipping containers and has a wooden floor and stage and a large sound system. Subsidiary of the Wilde Renate club.

name: Freiheit Fünfzehn
desc: Club location and beautiful beer garden at the waterside in Köpenick. The party area includes a concert location on a former cargo ship on the water, a dance club called [http://poparty-berlin.de/ Pop.arty] and a bar cal

name: Freischwimmer
desc: Bar at the river on a ponton with good food and drinks, good for chilling.

name: Haus Zenner
desc: Restaurant with beer garden and live music venue where Jazz and Swing bands perform regularly. It is one of the successors of the legendary Eierschale Jazz club which was located in Berlin-Dahlem from 1956 to 2000.

name: Hoppetosse
desc: This is a club for minimal techno and house located on a permanently docked excursion ship on the Spree river, the MS Hoppetosse. It is the winter venue for the Club der Visionäre. It has one dance floor and a Martion Bu

name: Insel Berlin
desc: Club on the Insel der Jugend island on the Spree river with three floors, music varies from reggae to techno to indie to gothic.

name: Rummelsburg
desc: Techno festivals, raves and beach bars right at the waterside and the old Rummelsburg power plant.

name: Restaurant Aarju
desc: Indian-Singaporean food busy on weekends, reservation recommended

name: Fishermans Restaurant
desc: A fish place with a terrace with views of the lake
